liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dancin' in the Streets** (1 review): Listener loves this opener and hopes the band keeps bringing it out in future shows [8]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: Dancin' in the Streets [18]

## The recordings

- **deadco2017-06-09** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **dead2017-06-09.mk4_flac24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience recording very clean, and says it captures the crowd's enthusiasm for what they were hearing [7]
- **dco2017-06-09.aud.flac24**: audience recording; 18 songs; 180 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **dead2017-06-09.mk22_flac24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 180 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2017-06-09**: taped by Richie Stankiewicz; transferred by Richie Stankiewicz; source: DPA 4021/4061 MTX SD744t 24/96->16/44 [1]. Also: Two sources: DPA 4021 mics through a Grace Luni preamp to an SD 744T, plus DPA 4061 mics to the same recorder; Mics were on a Jacklin disc on a tripod, 7-8 feet high, in the sweet spot; Richie Stankiewicz recorded and transferred it, dated 2017-06-12 [1]
- **dead2017-06-09.mk4_flac24**: taped by Bennett Schwartz; transferred by Coloartist; source: Schoeps mk4>DinA>KC5>CMC6>analog>788T (HPF 0) 24/48 [3]. Also: Taped front-of-board/DFC style, about 40 feet back from the stage at dead center, with mics 7 feet high; Chain: 788t recorder, then WaveLab 5 and CDWave edits, then FLAC level 7, tagged with Foobar2000's Live Show Tagger [3]
- **dco2017-06-09.aud.flac24**: taped by Jeff Jansen   Texasdragonfly Productions; transferred by Jeff Jansen   Texasdragonfly Productions; source: Church Audio CA-11's (NP) (DR) > Zoom H1 Samsung EVO 16GB microSD 24/48.wav [2]
- **dead2017-06-09.mk22_flac24**: taped by Bennett Schwartz; transferred by Coloartist; source: mk22>NOS>KC5>CMC6>analog>788T (HPF 0) 24/48 [4]
